meta.siteDescription: Basque cider house reservations — seasonal kitchen, txotx services, and long-table dining.

hero.title: Fire, cider, and the pace of the season
hero.lead: Basque cider house · seasonal kitchen · long tables. Reserve your place at the long table — txotx services, cider from the barrel, and a kitchen that follows the calendar.

menuSection.title: Kitchen tied to the orchard and the grill
menuSection.description: Final dishes and pricing will be managed from the admin panel. These cards preview the tone of the house menu.

txotx.title: Txotx midday
txotx.body: Cod omelette, steak, cheese, and walnuts — cider poured from the kupela between courses.
txotx.alt: Seasonal plate on a rustic table

grill.title: Evening grill
grill.body: Wood-fire txuleta, garden peppers, and shared sides. Service at unhurried cider-house rhythm.
grill.alt: Warm dining room with set tables

cellar.title: Sunday cellar
cellar.body: Lighter menu with local cheese, txakoli pairings, and pastry from the same stone oven.

season.title: Txotx season
season.body: From January through April, cider flows directly from the barrel. Book a midday txotx service and stay for the fire-grilled menu.

experiencesSection.title: More than a reservation slot
experiencesSection.description: Special services will tie into season rules and capacity in later phases. Icons mark experience types guests can filter when booking goes live.
experiencesSection.imageAlt: Long table with guests sharing a meal

txotx.title: Barrel-side txotx
txotx.body: Guided visits to the cellar with controlled pours and timed seatings during cider season.

evenings.title: Basque evenings
evenings.body: Occasional trikitixa sets and communal suppers — dates published when seasons are confirmed.

orchard.title: Orchard walks
orchard.body: Short guided walks among apple trees before selected Sunday services (weather permitting).
